description: Catalogue of the legal agreement templates in the templates/ directory.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for two parties to protect each other's confidential information. Used together with a cover page that sets the business terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms under which a provider supplies a cloud service to a customer for a subscription period.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms under which a provider licenses software to a customer for installation and use.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a provider performing services for a customer under one or more statements of work (SOWs).

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a cloud service's uptime target and the remedies when it is not met. Supplements a cloud service agreement.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: A short-term agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product before committing to a longer-term deal.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: An agreement giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for two companies cooperating on a business relationship, with each party's obligations set out in a cover page.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a provider processing personal data on behalf of a customer. Supplements a commercial agreement.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a provider handling protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a customer. Supplements a commercial agreement.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Terms covering a provider's AI services, including customer input and generated output. Supplements a commercial agreement.
